name: rhc-digital
description: Rabino Holdings Corporation Digital & Web3 Ecosystem - Month 1 foundation

scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @rhc/config && npm run build -w @rhc/types && npm run build -w @rhc/shared && npm run build -w @rhc/validation && npm run build -w @rhc/ui && npm run build -w @rhc/database
scripts.build:customer: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rhc/customer-web
scripts.build:admin: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rhc/admin-web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rhc/api
scripts.build:all: npm run build:customer && npm run build:admin && npm run build:api
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
